calls.statement:
SELECT tier, is_current, (valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31') AS open_ended, COUNT(*) AS versions, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, MIN(valid_from) AS min_from, MAX(valid_from) AS max_from
FROM dim_member GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

SELECT
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_member WHERE is_current) AS current_rows,
 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member) AS all_members,
 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member WHERE is_current) AS members_with_current,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND valid_to <> DATE '9999-12-31') AS current_but_closed,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_member WHERE NOT is_current AND valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31') AS open_not_current,
 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member WHERE DATE '2026-10-07' BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to AND tier='Gold') AS gold_on_req_date,
 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND tier='Gold' AND join_date > DATE '2026-10-07') AS future_join,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND tier='Gold' AND member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE tier='Gold' AND NOT is_current)) AS gold_before_too,
 (SELECT MAX(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) AS last_sale,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE tier NOT IN ('Basic','Silver','Gold') OR tier IS NULL)) AS odd_tier

WITH active AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  WHERE f.sale_date > DATE '2026-10-04' - 364 AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2026-10-04'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_gold
FROM active a JOIN dim_member c ON c.member_id = a.member_id AND c.is_current AND c.tier = 'Gold'
